name: bhq
title: PC Build Questionnaire
description: Plan a new PC build: share your budget, country, purchase date, games, resolution and component preferences with Relics on Discord.

variants.label: Bot questionnaire
variants.content:
# PC Build Questionnaire

Please provide answers to all questions in one message. Use **Shift + Enter** on PC or **Enter** on mobile to move to the next line.

**Important:** If you don't plan on purchasing your components within the next 7 days, please wait until you're closer to your intended purchase date before submitting your request. This helps us provide recommendations based on current pricing, availability and hardware options.
*(Reason is [here](https://discord.com/channels/1354544808273772626/1566961999315861535))*

**1.** When are you planning to purchase your PC parts? (If it is more than 7 days please come back later)

**2.** What's your total budget, and which country are you purchasing from? *(Please use your local currency.)*

**3.** If you're located in the US or Canada, do you have access to a nearby Micro Center or Canada Computers store?

**4.** What will you primarily use the PC for, and at which resolution? *(Please mention the games you play or professional applications you work with.)*

**5.** Do you have any particular preferences regarding the build's appearance or design? *(For example: AIO cooling, case size, overall style, preferred colors, etc.)*

**6.** Should peripherals be included in your budget? *(Monitor, keyboard, mouse, headset, etc.)*

**7.** Which connectivity options are required? *(Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, etc.)*

**8.** Are there any other requirements or details we should consider? *(Storage capacity, overclocking, components you already own, willingness to buy used or refurbished hardware, etc.)*

name: photoguide
title: PC Troubleshooting Photo Guide
description: Help Discord specialists troubleshoot your PC with clear photos of the motherboard, power connections, graphics card and cables.

variants.label: Discord tag
variants.content:
# Provide the Following Pictures
Make sure pictures are **NOT BLURRY** and at the **CORRECT ANGLE**.

If you have a modular PSU, also photograph the cables plugged into it.

Photograph the full interior, motherboard model, RAM, graphics card, motherboard power connectors and the rear cable connections. Keep the PC off and unplugged while inspecting internal cables. Never open the PSU enclosure. Avoid showing serial numbers or personal information.

The original example image is currently unavailable; ask your Discord specialist if you need help choosing the angles.

name: biosupdate
title: How to Update Your BIOS
description: Prepare for a motherboard BIOS update: identify the exact model, save your BitLocker recovery key and follow manufacturer instructions.

variants.label: Discord tag
variants.content:
# How to Update Your BIOS
1. Identify your exact motherboard model and hardware revision, or your exact prebuilt/laptop model. Use the manufacturer’s support page and manual for that model.
2. Back up important files and save your BitLocker recovery key somewhere you can access without this PC. If BitLocker is enabled, follow the manufacturer’s instructions to suspend protection before the update and resume it afterwards.
3. Read the BIOS release notes and update instructions, including any required intermediate version. Download the correct firmware directly from the manufacturer.
4. Prepare and extract the update exactly as instructed. The USB format, file name and update method vary by model.
5. Enter the firmware update utility (often Q-Flash, EZ Flash, M-Flash or Instant Flash) and select the correct file. Use stable power and do not interrupt the update.
6. After completion, review BIOS settings and boot order, then confirm that BitLocker protection has resumed.

**Do not turn off the PC while the firmware update is running.**

[Microsoft: suspend BitLocker for firmware updates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-client/windows-security/suspend-bitlocker-protection-non-Microsoft-updates)

name: cmos
title: How to Reset CMOS
description: Reset motherboard BIOS settings using the procedure in your motherboard manual, with power disconnected and settings recorded first.

variants.label: Discord tag
variants.content:
# How to Reset CMOS
Resetting CMOS restores BIOS settings. Record important settings first and have your BitLocker recovery key available.

1. Check your motherboard or device manual for the correct CMOS reset procedure. Methods and waiting times differ by model.
2. Shut down, switch off the power supply and unplug the power cable. Never open the power supply itself.
3. Follow the manual’s instructions for the Clear CMOS button, designated pins or removable coin-cell battery. Do not short unidentified pins or force a battery connector.
4. If the manual calls for battery removal, note its orientation and reinstall it as instructed.
5. Reconnect power and start the PC. Enter BIOS to review the clock, boot order and other settings.

For a laptop or a device with an internal battery, ask a specialist before opening it.

name: cfeatures
title: Controller Features Explained
description: Understand hair triggers, remappable buttons, modular parts, gyro aiming and rumble before choosing a controller for your setup.

variants.label: Discord tag
variants.content:
## Controller Features
1. **Hair trigger**: shorter travel for faster firing, useful in shooters.
2. **Macro / turbo functions**: automate repeated button presses or combos.
3. **Remappable buttons**: customize which buttons do what.
4. **Adjustable stick tension**: change joystick resistance for precision or speed.
5. **modularity**: the ability to change the layout of a controller (Xbox (asymmetric)/PS (symm)/Custom). Or swap specific parts only, i.e joysticks.
6. **Swappable face buttons**: change button style or layout (Xbox/Switch).
7. **Gyro controls**: motion-based aiming or movement.
8. **Rumble motors**: mechanical components that create physical vibrations to improve immersion.

name: chq
title: Controller Recommendation Questionnaire
description: Share your budget, platforms, favourite games, grip, hand measurements and feature preferences to get controller advice on Discord.

variants.label: Bot questionnaire
variants.content:
# Controller Recommendation Questionnaire

Looking for a new controller? Fill out the questionnaire below so we can help you find one that suits your needs.

-# Answer all questions in a single message using Shift + Enter for line breaks.

**1. Budget & Availability**
How much are you willing to spend? Include your local currency, country and any preferred retailers.

**2. Platform Compatibility**
Which platforms will you use the controller on?
-# E.g. PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch or mobile.

**3. Games & Usage**
What types of games do you primarily play? Include a few game titles as examples.

**4. Connectivity**
Do you prefer a wired controller, a wireless controller or one that supports both?

**5. Features & Functionality**
Which features are important to you?
- Hair triggers / trigger stops
- Macro or turbo functionality
- Remappable buttons
- Adjustable stick tension
- Modular or replaceable components
- Swappable face buttons (Xbox/Switch layout)
- Gyroscopic controls
- Vibration / rumble

-# Use [Controller Features](https://relicstech.site/tags/controller-features/) for a brief explanation of each feature.

**6. Hand Measurements**
What are your hand's length and width? Follow the measurement guide attached below.
-# You may skip this question if you cannot measure your hands.

**7. Previous Controller Experience**
Which controllers have you used before? What did you like or dislike about their comfort, ergonomics and functionality?

**8. Stick Layout**
Which analogue stick configuration do you prefer?
- Asymmetric (Xbox style)
- Symmetric (PlayStation style)
- Custom / No preference

**9. Shape & Ergonomics**
Which controller shape feels most comfortable to you?
- Xbox
- Nintendo Switch Pro
- DualShock 1–4
- DualSense
- Other / No preference

**10. Additional Requirements**
Is there anything else you're looking for in your next controller?
-# E.g. Hall Effect or TMR sticks, polling rate, battery life, weight or build quality.

-# The more information you provide, the more accurate our recommendations will be.

variants.label: Discord tag
variants.content:
# Spec-ify
Spec-ify generates a detailed overview of your PC's hardware and software. This information can be very useful when we're trying to identify and troubleshoot issues with your system.

Step 1 - Download Spec-ify
Download Spec-ify from the official website: https://spec-ify.com/

Step 2 - Open Spec-ify
Run Specify.exe after downloading it. Only run the download if you trust its source and have verified that it came from the official website. Ask a specialist if a security warning appears.
If you'd like to keep certain information private, open Settings and disable the collection of details such as your Windows username, serial numbers, and network information.

Step 3 - Run the scan
Click Start and allow Spec-ify to scan your system. Wait until the process has finished.

Step 4 - Share your results
After the scan, Spec-ify will open a webpage containing your system report and automatically copy the URL.
Return to Discord and send the link here.

Review the report before sharing. Do not post passwords, recovery keys or other private information.

name: cleanw
title: Clean a Disk in Windows Setup
description: Use DiskPart from Windows Setup only after backing up your files and verifying the target disk. Cleaning removes its partitions.

variants.label: Discord tag
variants.content:
# Clean a Disk with DiskPart
**Warning: `clean` removes all partitions from the selected disk, making its files inaccessible. Back up anything you need before proceeding. Do not use this to troubleshoot a disk that contains files you want to recover.**

In Windows Setup, press **Shift + F10** to open Command Prompt.

1. Start DiskPart: `diskpart`
2. List disks: `list disk`
3. Select the intended disk: `select disk X` (replace X with its disk number).
4. Verify the disk model, size and volumes: `detail disk`. Stop if you are unsure.
5. Only when you have confirmed the correct disk and your backup: `clean`
6. For a GPT setup, optionally run: `convert gpt`

Run `exit`, close Command Prompt, then refresh the drive list in Windows Setup. Select the unallocated space on the intended disk and continue; Windows creates the required partitions.

[Microsoft: DiskPart clean](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/clean)
[Microsoft: create partition primary](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/create-partition-primary)

name: clean
title: Clean a Disk with DiskPart
description: Check and clean a selected disk with DiskPart, understand the data-loss consequences, and optionally prepare a new data partition.

variants.label: Discord tag
variants.content:
# Clean a Disk with DiskPart
**Warning: `clean` removes all partitions from the selected disk, making its files inaccessible. Back up anything you need before proceeding. Do not use this to troubleshoot a disk that contains files you want to recover.**

Open Command Prompt or Terminal as administrator.

1. Start DiskPart: `diskpart`
2. List disks: `list disk`
3. Select the intended disk: `select disk X` (replace X with its disk number).
4. Verify the disk model, size and volumes: `detail disk`. Stop if you are unsure.
5. Only when you have confirmed the correct disk and your backup: `clean`
6. For a GPT setup, optionally run: `convert gpt`

For a new data partition only (not Windows system installation), optionally run:
`create partition primary`
`format quick fs=ntfs`
`assign`
`exit`

The `assign` command selects an available drive letter.

[Microsoft: DiskPart clean](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/clean)

How do you usually sit? Do you sit cross-legged, tuck your legs underneath you or frequently change positions?

**5. Posture & Ergonomics**
Are there any posture-related concerns, discomfort or physical limitations we should consider?
-# E.g. lower back pain, neck discomfort or specific support requirements.

**6. Design & Aesthetics**
Do you have a preferred chair style, colour or material?
-# E.g. ergonomic office chair, gaming chair, mesh, fabric or leather.

**7. Adjustability & Features**
Are there any features you specifically want?
-# E.g. adjustable lumbar support, headrest, adjustable armrests, seat depth or reclining mechanism.

**8. Previous Chair Experience**
What chair are you currently using? What do you like or dislike about it?

**9. Additional Requirements**
Is there anything else you would like us to consider? Are you open to refurbished or second-hand chairs?
